page.title: Signals
page.desc: Demand and inventory signals per SKU — the inputs the pricing engine reads.
page.honest: All values are demand-model estimates derived from the catalog — not observed sales telemetry.

table.caption: Demand and inventory signals per SKU
table.name: Name

def.velocity: Modelled units per month at the current price — from the demand model, not observed sales.
def.elasticity: Price elasticity coefficient and its band; more negative means demand reacts harder to price moves.
def.coverage: How many competitor feeds report a price for this SKU.
def.daysSupply: Stock units divided by modelled daily velocity. “—” when velocity is zero.
def.risk: Stockout < 7d of supply, low < 14d, overstock > 90d — thresholds are demand-model estimates.
